directionSent: deep, resonant, booming, noble and ancient
heardByWhisper: The characters hear a loud flapping noise and then feel a warm jet of air hit their faces.  A huge silver dragon flies down to meet them.  The dragon lands, looks the party over, then says,  You have nothing that interests me.  If you wish to appease me, then go east and destroy the Kobold community there.  There you shall find a magical bottle which will help you in cleansing old flan of its evil.  After speaking, the dragon flies through an opening in the ceiling of the cave.  You exit the cave to continue your quest.
